name: dome-gallery
title: Dome Gallery
description: Photo grid wrapped onto the inside of a dome, so tiles curve away and shrink toward the edges of the frame.

meta.interaction: Dragging spins the dome left, right and slightly up or down, and it keeps coasting after you let go before settling. Clicking a tile lifts that photo off the curve and enlarges it flat in the centre; clicking again drops it back into its slot.
